name: OpenStreetMap contributors — Sylhet Division extract (points of interest)
notes: Geofabrik Bangladesh extract (https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/bangladesh-261117.osm.pbf), OSM data as of 2026-11-17T21:24:30Z, parsed locally with pyosmium by osm_rajshahi_division/fetch.py --division sylhet. Named POI-like nodes, ways and multipolygon relations (ways/relations by area centroid); unnamed kept only for ATM, fuel, toilets, drinking water with a public access tag, police, fire, ambulance, shelters. District/upazila by point-in-polygon against hdx_cod_ab_bgd_sylhet/boundaries.geojson (seed names via its crosswalk.csv). Community data: every row is unverified. Contacts are those published on the feature. ODbL is share-alike: a published database derived from these rows must be offered under ODbL with attribution. The .pbf is not committed (fetch.py downloads it again).
